product_metadata.title: Sauder Caraway Linen Tower, Soft White finish
features: Open shelving features cubbyhole divider for towel storage
Adjustable shelf behind frame and panel door with bead board insert
Reversible door opens left or right
Soft White finish with Slate finish accent
description: Add a little extra storage space to your bathroom with this linen tower from the Peppercorn collection. Find room for towels, tissues, décor and more on one of the two fixed open shelves. Behind the louver detailed door is an adjustable shelf for additional hidden storage. Finished in a sleek Soft White, this linen cabinet will add style and organization to your bathroom.
